svg.text: 13b Adjust stock of a ready-made item (popup)
Route: /admin/raw-materials?tab=ready-made (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin and Staff (admin site, signed in)
• Used for ready-made items (counted in pieces); raw materials have their own popup (14b). Starts empty: Save adjustment stays disabled until there is an amount that changes the stock and
a reason. Reasons: Restock / delivery received, Customer return, Damaged goods, Spoilage, Manual correction (recount), Other.
• Damaged goods and Spoilage can only lower stock; stock never goes below 0. The preview shows old → new count and the change. Every save is logged with who made it and shows in Stock
